license_required.quote: Unless licensed to practice under this act, no person shall represent himself to the public as being a dietitian or a licensed dietitian.

type.quote: The dietetics licensing board is created. The board shall regulate the practice of dietetics in the state

age_minimum.quote: Has reached the age of majority

moral_character_required.quote: Has not been convicted of a felony or a misdemeanor that relates adversely to the practice of dietetics, or the ability to practice dietetics

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or post baccalaureate degree from a United States regionally accredited college or university with a major course of study in human nutrition, nutrition education, public health nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management or an equivalent major course of study as approved by the board

required.quote: Has completed a documented supervised preprofessional practice experience component in dietetics of not less than nine hundred (900) hours under the supervision of a registered dietitian, a licensed dietitian or an individual with a doctoral degree

exams.name: Registration Examination for Dietitians (Commission on Dietetic Registration)
exams.notes: Or an examination of an equivalent level approved by the board. The board may contract with organizations capable of providing an examination meeting standards of the commission or an equivalent organization.
exams.quote: Has successfully completed the registration examination for dietitians administered by the commission or an examination of an equivalent level approved by the board

interval_years.quote: A licensed dietitian shall renew the license every two (2) years.

required.quote: The renewal request shall be accompanied by evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee has complied with this act and completed any applicable continuing education requirements.

available.quote: Reciprocity may be provided for dietitians licensed in other states which have laws at least as stringent as this act, or registered dietitians if their previous state of residence does not require licensure, provided that the applicant meets the requirements of W.S. 33-47-106.

requirements.value: Applicant must come from a state with laws at least as stringent as Wyoming's act, or be a registered dietitian if their previous state did not require licensure, and must meet the standard licensure requirements of W.S. 33-47-106.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or renewal of license to practice dietetics.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or renewal of license to practice dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes of incompetency as defined in the rules and regulations of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes of incompetency as defined in the rules and regulations of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to a drug or intoxicant to a degree that renders the licensee unsafe or unfit to practice dietetics.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to a drug or intoxicant to a degree that renders the licensee unsafe or unfit to practice dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by rules of the board, or has violated the code of ethics adopted and published by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by rules of the board, or has violated the code of ethics adopted and published by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has practiced dietetics under cover of any permit or license illegally or fraudulently obtained or issued, or under a license that has expired or been suspended.

definition_quote.value: "Dietetics" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, management, communication, and biological, physiological, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain optimal human health. "Dietetics" includes the nutrition care process and medical nutrition therapy. "Dietetics" does not include medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual

physician_referral_required.quote: "Medically prescribed diet" means a diet prescribed when specific food or nutrient levels need to be monitored, altered, or both, as a component of a treatment program from an individual whose health status is impaired or at risk due to disease, injury or surgery and may only be performed as initiated by or in consultation with a physician licensed in this state or an individual authorized by a state license to prescribe medical care
